decisive_items: an abrupt onset of an asymptomatic cutaneous eruption
a dense inflammatory neutrophilic infiltrate within the dermis, marked dermal edema, and no evidence of vasculitis
multiple papules and plaques of varying sizes on the dorsal forearms and nape of the neck, each showing a striking central depression that mimicked vesiculation
response.rationale: The biopsy findings of dense dermal neutrophilic infiltrate with marked edema and no vasculitis, together with abrupt onset of asymptomatic cutaneous lesions and peripheral neutrophilia, are characteristic of Sweet syndrome.
